# Third-party notice: envd

This directory contains the API specification (`spec/`) of **envd**, the in-sandbox daemon from
[e2b-dev/runtime](https://github.com/e2b-dev/runtime), copied unmodified from the tag and commit
recorded in `UPSTREAM`. The `agentry/envd` image builds the `envd` binary from the same commit,
